arStrings.szText: I have found a very strange object. The dull surface blurs, fading in and out as voices whisper. Perhaps one of the Seers may know what to make of it? I should look around Temis Plaza.
Bring the Trace of Echoes to a Seer
I have found a very strange object. The dull surface blurs, fading in and out as voices whisper. Perhaps one of the Seers may know what to make of it? I should look around Temis Plaza.
I have found a very strange object. The dull surface blurs, fading in and out as voices whisper. Perhaps one of the Seers may know what to make of it? I should look around Temis Plaza.
Seer Nevma says I've found a "trace of echoes"—evidence of the dead encroaching on the mortal world. It seems I must enter theirs to stop them...through the Sightless Eye.
I died...at least, it felt like death among the echoes, yet I've awakened back in Temis without a scratch. I must speak with Seer Nevma and tell her what happened.
I find myself in a realm of shadows. A hateful altar sits in the center, daring me to approach...to rouse the echoes of the dead.
